issues.explanation: In these passages, 率 meaning “to lead/command” is pronounced shuài, not lǜ.
Here 率 means “to lead” or “to command,” not the bound form meaning “ratio.”
关羽 is a personal name and must remain a single name segment; splitting it exposes misleading standalone glosses.
issues.suggested_fix: Merge each occurrence of 关 and 羽 into the name 关羽.

issues.explanation: In 带五百人 and 带刘备…, 带 means “to bring/take along,” not “band.”
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “to bring; to take along.”

issues.explanation: 百 is the number “hundred” in 五百人, not the surname Bai.
迎战 is a natural lexical verb meaning “to meet the enemy in battle”; splitting it hides the useful word.
issues.suggested_fix: Use the single word segment 迎战, glossed “to meet in battle; to engage.”

issues.explanation: 翼 means “wing” in 两翼 and is not a personal name or surname.
issues.suggested_fix: Mark 翼 as a word and gloss it as “wing.”

issues.explanation: In 解了青州之围, 解 means “to relieve/lift” the siege, not the surname Xie.
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “to relieve; to lift (a siege).”

issues.explanation: 围 means “siege” or “encirclement” in 青州之围, not the surname Wei.
往 is a directional word/preposition meaning “to; toward,” not a grammatical particle.
issues.suggested_fix: Mark it as a word and gloss it as “to; toward.”

issues.explanation: In 令关羽、张飞… and 令他…, 令 means “to order; to command,” not the unrelated dictionary reference 脊令.
本部 refers to one’s own troops or unit here, not headquarters.
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “one’s own troops; one’s unit.”

issues.explanation: 给一千兵 means “to give/provide one thousand troops,” not merely “to.”
风火 is not a lexical expression here. The sentence contains 大风 “strong wind” and 火攻 “fire attack.”
issues.suggested_fix: Split as 大 + 风 + 火攻, with 火攻 as “fire attack.”

issues.explanation: 长社 is a place name and should be kept together; splitting it produces misleading ordinary-word glosses.
issues.suggested_fix: Merge 长 and 社 into the place name 长社, pinyin Chángshè.

issues.explanation: The historical general’s name 朱隽 is pronounced Zhū Jùn, not Zhū Juàn.
诱敌 is a natural lexical verb meaning “to lure the enemy”; splitting it hides the useful word.
issues.suggested_fix: Use the single word segment 诱敌, glossed “to lure the enemy.”

issues.explanation: 出战 is a natural lexical verb meaning “to go into battle,” rather than an arbitrary combination of 出 and 战.
issues.suggested_fix: Use the single word segment 出战, glossed “to go into battle; to engage.”
